Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function asin() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultASin  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).asin (); // creates a UnaryASinUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultASin  =  asin(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryASinUGen
See also:
